limitations: This is a bounded static permission review. Engine loading, command success, save compatibility, execution timing, longitudinal reevaluation, AI quality, balance and in-game performance remain unknown.

Core RTTI/parser/atom/type/database/reader roots were rediscovered from current PE. Some wrappers/callers were nominated by old masked windows and reviewed by current member/type/operand/caller correspondence; no claim of independent naming of every wrapper.
Operand comparison ignores relative branch/call targets and RIP displacements; it supplements the current typed graph and cannot authorize unknown callees by itself. Embedded parser tables are data.

Reused and audited tools/ci/engine_discovery_1151.py PE/RTTI/token interpreter for root replay; independently checked actual current operands and producer-to-consumer boundaries rather than treating its result or hash as attestation.

Controlled discovery checks Capstone native DLL hash, import path and version. Its recorded wheel archive hash is not automatically validated by that script; this review rechecked the DLL and version, not the wheel archive.
No full acceptance gate or test suite was run in this review; the parent is coordinating those checks separately.
